name: NeRF-Casting
definition: A method that improves NeRF's view-dependent appearance by casting reflection rays from points along camera rays into the NeRF geometry to render feature vectors, which are then decoded into color using a small MLP, rather than querying a large MLP for outgoing radiance.
summary: NeRF-Casting synthesizes photorealistic specular reflections by casting reflection rays into NeRF geometry to render feature vectors, avoiding large MLPs and offering low computational overhead.
